headline: Hariom Pipe Industries submits voting results and AGM scrutinizer report
summary: Hariom Pipe Industries Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. This is a routine regulatory filing following the conclusion of shareholder proceedings. Retail investors should note this is standard compliance procedure with no immediate impact on business operations or share price. The filing completes the mandatory post-AGM reporting requirements for the company.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on share price.
